
## Summary

**Normalize panel titles and operator vocabulary** (residual after DUX5)

Monitor/Track/Inspect/Review prefixes and long questions inflate titles.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-03`
- DUX code: `DUX6-12`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: all titles

## Concrete change

Use noun phrase or short operator question; move scope to badge and action verbs to buttons.

## Expected effect

Panel titles become scannable and fit two lines.

## Acceptance criteria

- No required title exceeds two lines at 1366 px; action verbs appear only on actions.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Copy style guide.

## Risk

Renaming may affect search/bookmarks only if titles are externally referenced.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7125 DUX5-12 closed — residual: Approach B titles; operator nouns in cards only

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX6 epic (#7139)
